title: 1997 AHSME Problem 6
statement: Consider the sequence \[ 1,-2,3,-4,5,-6,\ldots, \] whose \(n\)th term is \((-1)^{n+1}n.\) What is the average of the first \(200\) terms of the sequence?

solutions.text: Each pair \((2k-1)-2k\) has sum \(-1.\) The \(100\) pairs therefore total \(-100,\) and their \(200\)-term average is \(-\frac{100}{200}=-0.5.\) The correct answer is B.
hints: Group consecutive terms into odd-even pairs
